title: Toward Optimal Second-Order Path-Length Guarantee for Adversarial Multi-Armed Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2608.15996v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study second-order path-length regret in adversarial $K$-armed bandits against oblivious loss sequences. Bubeck et al. [2019] designed an algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K+\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,1}})$ regret, where $Q_{\infty,1}$ is the first-order path length, and left open whether $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\text{poly}(K)\sqrt{1+Q_{\infty,2}})$ regret is achievable under bandit feedback, where $Q_{\infty,2}$ is the second-order path length. Somewhat surprisingly, we resolve this question positively by showing that with a more involved analysis, the exact same algorithm of Bubeck et al. [2019] achieves $\mathcal{O}\left(K\log(KT)+\sqrt{K\log(KT)\bigl(1+Q_{\infty,2}\bigr)}\right)$ expected regret when $Q_{\infty,2}$ is known, where $T$ is the horizon. This matches the $\Omega(\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,2}})$ lower bound up to logarithmic factors and additive terms. We further remove the knowledge of $Q_{\infty,2}$ using an adaptive res

translated_title: 面向对抗性多臂老虎机的最优二阶路径长度保证
translated_abstract: 我们研究了针对遗忘损失序列的对抗性$K$臂老虎机中的二阶路径长度遗憾。Bubeck等人[2019]设计了一种算法，实现了$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K+\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,1}})$的遗憾，其中$Q_{\infty,1}$是一阶路径长度，并留下了在老虎机反馈下是否可实现$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\text{poly}(K)\sqrt{1+Q_{\infty,2}})$遗憾的开放问题，其中$Q_{\infty,2}$是二阶路径长度。有点令人惊讶的是，我们通过更深入的分析正面解决了这个问题，表明当$Q_{\infty,2}$已知时，Bubeck等人[2019]的完全相同算法实现了$\mathcal{O}\left(K\log(KT)+\sqrt{K\log(KT)\bigl(1+Q_{\infty,2}\bigr)}\right)$的期望遗憾，其中$T$是时间范围。这与$\Omega(\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,2}})$的下界匹配，直到对数因子和附加项。我们进一步通过自适应调整消除了对$Q_{\infty,2}$的已知性要求。
tldr: 我们证明了Bubeck等人的算法在对抗性多臂老虎机中实现了与二阶路径长度下界匹配的最优遗憾，无需修改算法，并进一步实现了对未知二阶路径长度的自适应处理。
en_tdlr: We show that Bubeck et al.'s algorithm achieves optimal regret matching the second-order path-length lower bound in adversarial bandits, without modification, and further adapt to unknown second-order path length.
